covered.label: MTR urban heavy-rail (Island, Tsuen Wan, Kwun Tong, Tseung Kwan O, Tung Chung, Tuen Ma, East Rail, South Island)
covered.detail: All 95 catalogued stations, eight lines, live MTR Next Train departures.

covered.label: Airport Express (AEL) at Hong Kong, Kowloon, Tsing Yi
covered.detail: Board eligibility verdict 'in' (Tim, 27 Sep 2026) — walk-up boardable, no reservation, no check-in barrier. Live departures toward Airport / AsiaWorld-Expo shown at these three urban stations only.

covered.label: Disneyland Resort Line (DRL) at Sunny Bay
covered.detail: Board eligibility verdict 'in' — walk-up boardable, no reservation, no barrier. Live departures toward Disneyland Resort shown at Sunny Bay only.

notCovered.label: Light Rail (MTR LRT)
notCovered.detail: Separate feed (lrt/getSchedule) and separate stop identity from the urban heavy-rail network. Not shown yet.

notCovered.label: High Speed Rail (Hong Kong West Kowloon)
notCovered.detail: Not in catalog — separate non-urban station.

notCovered.label: MTR Bus, Peak Tram, Star Ferry, Ngong Ping 360
notCovered.detail: Not covered — different vehicle types/services, out-mode.

notCovered.label: Airport, AsiaWorld-Expo and Disneyland Resort stations
notCovered.detail: Not in catalog. Airport Express / Disneyland Resort Line trains toward these appear as text destinations from their in-catalog boarding stations only, never as a station a rider can pick a board for.

stations: 95 MTR urban heavy-rail stations, plus the board-eligibility-approved Airport Express (3 stations) and Disneyland Resort Line (1 station) product-line calls layered onto existing stations.
notes: Admiralty is the inner hub where Tsuen Wan, Island, South Island and East Rail cross; it never appears as a direction. Data: data.gov.hk / MTR Corporation Limited / DATA.GOV.HK — attribution required by the data.gov.hk Terms and Conditions of Use (Version 1.2).
